description: This Java class 'DefaultGatewayNotificationsService' handles gateway device notifications such as device updates and deletions, sending RPC requests to the gateway device accordingly.

classes.name: DefaultGatewayNotificationsService
classes.description: Service class for handling gateway device notifications, such as device updates and deletions, by sending RPC requests to the gateway device.

methods.name: onDeviceUpdated
methods.description: Handles device update events; sends a rename RPC request if the device is connected to a gateway.

methods.name: onDeviceDeleted
methods.description: Handles device deletion events; sends a delete RPC request to the gateway device.

methods.name: formDeviceToGatewayRPCRequest
methods.description: Creates an RPC request object for communication with the gateway device.

methods.name: getGatewayDeviceIdFromAdditionalInfoInDevice
methods.description: Extracts the gateway device ID from the device's additional info if available.
